title: Fees Taken Off the Paid Month on a Professional Email Annual Conversion
content:
Collections desk rule. The fees taken off the paid-month value of a Professional Email annual conversion are the fees the renewal charge that opened the current term carried, read from the calendar days from the term start date to that charge's charge date, since a fee is part of what a charge billed but never of what a month is credited.

**Late-payment fee.** 15.00 for 15 days or more; 10.00 from 4 days up to 14; 5.00 from 1 day up to 3.

**Reinstatement charge, added to it.** Where those days less the product's payment grace days (7 on Harborline Mail products, 10 on Microsoft 365 Business products) less 1 — the days the subscription had been suspended — are 15 or more, the reinstatement charge 20.00 is added; from 4 up to 14, the reinstatement charge 10.00.

**Otherwise**, including a renewal charged on or before its period start, a new-subscription charge and no renewal charge on record, no fee is taken off.

## Cases (hypothetical Harborline Mail subscription, grace of 7 days)

| Days from term start to the charge date | Late-payment fee | Days suspended | Reinstatement charge | Taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | — | none | 0.00 |
| 2 | 5.00 | below zero | none | 5.00 |
| 9 | 10.00 | 1 | none | 10.00 |
| 13 | 10.00 | 5 | 10.00 | 20.00 |
| 24 | 15.00 | 16 | 20.00 | 35.00 |
